Design a comprehensive implementation plan to transform the CROBOT SaaS app into a mature, production-grade product. This is a complete UI/UX overhaul covering performance, design consistency, bugs, and UX polish.

## App Context
- Tech Stack: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Supabase + Recharts
- SPA (no SSR), auth via Supabase, 27 pages, 70+ components
- Primary path: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT

## Audit Findings Summary

### Performance Issues (CRITICAL)
1. QueryClient in App.tsx has NO configuration (no staleTime, gcTime, retry) → memory bloat
2. Agent engine in AgentWorkspace.tsx uses `forceUpdate` anti-pattern causing full re-renders on every message
3. setTimeout timers in agent-engine.ts leak when user navigates away (no cleanup)
4. Admin tables: no useMemo/useCallback for handlers, full re-renders on each keystroke
5. Search in admin hooks: client-side filtering after fetching ALL records
6. No debouncing on search inputs (uses onBlur/Enter instead of real-time)
7. Dashboard: completedScans.filter() runs on every render, no useMemo

### Design System Issues (HIGH)
1. Arbitrary text sizes: `text-[10px]`, `text-[11px]`, `text-[13px]`, `text-[28px]` everywhere
2. Hardcoded hex colors: `bg-[#FF5F57]`, `bg-[#FEBC2E]`, `bg-[#28C840]` in BrowserFrame
3. AdminLayout hardcoded: `bg-[hsl(222,47%,11.2%)]` should use design token
4. Inconsistent opacity: `white/[0.06]`, `white/[0.08]` non-standard values
5. No dark mode CSS variables defined (next-themes installed but unused)
6. Inconsistent hover states across components
7. Hardcoded green-500/600 colors instead of success semantic tokens
8. AgentStatusBadge uses hardcoded amber-50, blue-50, violet-50, emerald-50

### UX Bugs (HIGH)
1. PDF generation errors only go to console.log, not user toast
2. Edge function failures silent (no user-facing error shown)
3. Copy-to-clipboard setTimeout stacks up on multiple clicks
4. Feature flags only work in localStorage (not synced)
5. Audit log failures don't alert admin
6. Password validation inconsistent: login=6 chars, signup=8 chars
7. Missing loading states for profile updates, password changes
8. Sidebar collapse state not persisted

### Missing States (MEDIUM)
1. Error boundaries missing for charts/data rendering
2. No loading spinners on profile save, password change
3. Score trend labels "W1","W2" not user-friendly (should be dates)
4. No retry UI on scan failure (only toast)
5. AuditReport annotation dots break on mobile
6. Browser frame mockup not responsive
7. Pricing table breaks on mobile

### Responsive Design (MEDIUM)
1. Tables need horizontal scroll on mobile
2. Annotation dots in AuditReport use fixed percentages (break on mobile)
3. Pricing table feature matrix not mobile-friendly
4. TopBar `max-w-[200px]` hardcoded truncation

## Key Files to Modify
- `src/App.tsx` — QueryClient config
- `src/index.css` — dark mode variables, custom scrollbar
- `src/components/TopBar.tsx` — fix arbitrary sizes, polish
- `src/components/AppSidebar.tsx` — persist collapse state, cleanup
- `src/components/AdminLayout.tsx` — use design tokens, remove hardcoded bg
- `src/components/shared/BrowserFrame.tsx` — replace hex colors
- `src/components/shared/FindingCard.tsx` — fix copy timeout, min-w-0
- `src/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx` — fix animation, replace rgba
- `src/components/shared/ScanProgressTimeline.tsx` — replace hardcoded green
- `src/components/agents/AgentStatusBadge.tsx` — use semantic colors
- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — add useMemo, fix week labels
- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — mobile responsive, error toast for PDF
- `src/pages/Scan.tsx` — retry UI, responsive browser frame
- `src/pages/Pricing.tsx` — mobile table, fix CTA labels
- `src/pages/Settings.tsx` — loading states, fix password validation
- `src/pages/AgentWorkspace.tsx` — replace forceUpdate, optimize renders
- `src/pages/admin/Users.tsx` — add useCallback, debounce
- `src/pages/admin/Scans.tsx` — add useCallback, debounce
- `src/lib/agent-engine.ts` — fix timer cleanup
- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — fix silent edge function error
- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — fix PDF error handling

## Requirements
1. Do NOT touch mock data in AgentHub/AgentWorkspace (per CLAUDE.md)
2. Stay within existing component architecture
3. All TypeScript must remain strict (no `any`)
4. All changes must be production-grade, not prototype-grade
5. Prioritize visible UX impact over internal refactoring

Create a detailed, file-by-file implementation plan grouped by priority:
- Phase 1: Critical performance fixes (QueryClient, memoization)
- Phase 2: Design system cleanup (tokens, arbitrary values)
- Phase 3: UX bug fixes (errors, loading states, responsive)
- Phase 4: Polish (animations, sidebar persistence, dark mode prep)

For each phase, list specific files and exactly what to change. Focus on minimal, targeted changes with maximum UX impact.

1	# ConvertScan (CROBOT)
2	
3	AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.
4	
5	## Stack
6	- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
7	- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + Edge Functions + Storage)
8	- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
9	- **Billing**: Stripe (subscriptions)
10	- **Email**: Resend
11	- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
12	- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway
13	
14	## Architecture
15	- SPA (Vite) — no SSR. All backend logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime)
16	- Auth: Supabase Auth (Google OAuth + email/password)
17	- Database: PostgreSQL via Supabase with RLS on every table
18	- Storage: Supabase Storage for screenshots
19	- Edge Functions: Deno runtime, import from URLs (not npm)
20	
21	## Key Files
22	- `src/App.tsx` — routing, AuthProvider wrapping
23	- `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — auth state management
24	- `src/pages/Scan.tsx` — core scan submission flow
25	- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — report display with 7 CRO pillars
26	- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — KPI cards, recent scans, charts
27	- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — all scan CRUD operations
28	- `src/hooks/use-scan-results.ts` — pillar results queries
29	- `src/hooks/use-billing.ts` — Stripe checkout/portal
30	- `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts` — client-side PDF generation
31	- `src/lib/supabase.ts` — Supabase client
32	- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits
33	- `src/lib/score-utils.ts` — scoring algorithm, color mapping
34	- `src/types/index.ts` — all TypeScript types
35	- `src/types/database.ts` — Supabase database types
36	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/` — main scan orchestrator
37	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/prompts.ts` — AI system prompts
38	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/scoring.ts` — scoring engine
39	- `supabase/functions/pagespeed/` — Google PageSpeed integration
40	- `supabase/functions/stripe-checkout/` — Stripe checkout session
41	- `supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/` — Stripe event handler
42	- `supabase/functions/send-email/` — Resend email service
43	
44	## Database Tables
45	- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
46	- `scans` — audit scan records
47	- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
48	- `integrations` — third-party service connections
49	
50	## The 7 CRO Pillars
51	1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
52	2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
53	3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
54	4. Visual Hierarchy (12% weight)
55	5. Mobile Experience (13% weight)
56	6. Content & Copy (11% weight)
57	7. Page Performance (9% weight)
58	
59	## Pricing Tiers
60	- Free: 3 scans/month, basic score, top 3 suggestions
61	- Pro ($49/mo): 25 scans, all suggestions, AI rewrites, PDF, monitoring
62	- Agency ($199/mo): 500 scans, white-label, multi-client, API
63	
64	## Commands
65	- `npm run dev` — start dev server (port 8080)
66	- `npm run build` — production build
67	- `npm run lint` — ESLint
68	- `npx supabase functions serve` — local edge functions
69	
70	## Environment Variables
71	### Frontend (.env.local)
72	- VITE_SUPABASE_URL
73	- VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
74	- VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
75	
76	### Supabase Edge Functions (secrets)
77	- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
78	- PAGESPEED_API_KEY
79	- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_URL
80	- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_API_KEY
81	- STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
82	- STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
83	- STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
84	- STRIPE_PRICE_AGENCY_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
85	- RESEND_API_KEY
86	- SITE_URL
87	
88	## Conventions
89	- All components use shadcn/ui from `@/components/ui/`
90	- Toast notifications via `sonner`
91	- React Query for all server state
92	- Supabase RLS enforces data isolation — no manual auth checks needed in queries
93	- Edge functions return JSON with CORS headers
94	- Findings stored as JSONB arrays in scan_results
95	- Score colors: green (70+), amber (40-69), red (0-39)
96	
97	## Agent Hub (UI-only feature)
98	- `src/pages/AgentHub.tsx` and `src/pages/AgentWorkspace.tsx` are UI demo pages
99	- They intentionally use `MOCK_AGENTS`, `MOCK_AGENT_TASKS`, `MOCK_AGENT_MESSAGES`, `MOCK_AGENT_ACTIVITY` from `src/lib/mock-agents.ts`
100	- The agent engine (`src/lib/agent-engine.ts`) is a client-side simulation — no real backend calls
101	- Do not replace mock data in agent pages without a real backend implementation to replace it with
